verdict.rationale: User approved plan: 2 test-first tasks, frontend-only fix for both dislike and like feedback paths.

Verified CR-001 (backend empty-string acceptance) directly against codemie backend: FeedbackRequest.response and FeedbackEntry.response are plain str with no length/validator constraints, and the POST /v1/feedback router passes the value through with no business-rule check — false positive. 2 deferred findings (delete-feedback missing await; request field same undefined-drop exposure) confirmed pre-existing/out-of-scope by user, left unfixed.

Real-browser Playwright verification: dislike/like on an empty-response message both send response:'' and succeed; mocked 422 shows the new friendly error toast. All 3 scenarios verified, zero unexpected console errors, no blocking issues.
